ValidationRule.description: Once a request reaches a terminal state (Applied/Ignored/Closed) it cannot be edited except to explicitly move it to Reopened. Forces the deliberate reopenRequest() path instead of silent field edits.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), OR( ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Applied'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Ignored'), ISPICKVAL(PRIORVALUE(Status__c), 'Closed') ), NOT(ISCHANGED(Status__c)) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This request is in a terminal state. Use Reopen to make further changes.
